findings.title: No-offer receive terminal result never requests the exact input handoff
findings.trigger: Deliver valid ZRQINIT in one PTY event, then peer cancellation or a protocol failure in a later event, before the first ZFILE offer. The connection itself stays open.
evidence: session zmodem.rs:585-618 starts a receive lease but emits no UI event
ssh_bridge_zmodem.rs:181-189 captures that lease and sets safety.active
terminal_zmodem.rs:369-400 only requests ResumeInput for a matching current card; no-offer certain terminal outcomes fall through
ssh_bridge_zmodem.rs:152-178 clears active only after exact ResumeInput and flushed writes
findings.impact: Ordinary input remains rejected and tab/window close remains blocked indefinitely; there is no current transfer card from which the user can cancel or recover.
findings.verification: Source-level control-flow proof, not independently recompiled or dynamically reproduced in production.
findings.recommended_change: Track the bridge lease independently of whether a file-offer card exists; a terminal event for that lease must schedule exact ResumeInput even if there has been no offer. Provide a cancellable receive-negotiation state without granting file authority.

findings.title: Shell completion during a blocked write drops queued terminal tail and exit
findings.trigger: Remote sends final bytes plus exit_status/close while an ordinary SSH write is suspended by flow control.
findings.impact: write_and_drain returns false as soon as the lifecycle watch ends; pump and run_with_protocol drop the byte queues instead of draining final terminal output/Exited to the UI.
findings.verification: Independently executed parent prebuilt stable binary, matching SHA256/inventory; no independent recompile.
findings.recommended_change: Stop the admitted write without restarting it, publish lifecycle completion, then retain the shell/output drain owner through ordered delivery of the queued terminal tail and exit event. Keep cancellation and backpressure bounded.

findings.title: A duplicate cancel rejection reopens an ended UI transfer
findings.trigger: Submit Cancel(id) twice while processing. Cancel remains enabled for Stage::Running. Controller emits Cancelled(id), then ActionRejected(id, Stale), since the first cancel removed its lease.
findings.impact: The late rejection resets Stage::Ended to Upload/Download; ordinary input and close stay blocked by the resurrected UI card although the bridge lease has ended. Re-prepare/re-cancel is stale and cannot end the resurrected card.
evidence: terminal_zmodem.rs:421 admits a second Cancel for the same current UUID, regardless of Stage
terminal_zmodem.rs:647-655 leaves cancel enabled in Running
session zmodem.rs:485-487 rejects a stale second cancel after end clears transfer
terminal_zmodem.rs:334-357 does not reject post-terminal ActionRejected notifications
findings.verification: Source-level control-flow proof only; no new test compiled.
findings.recommended_change: Ignore stale ActionRejected/Progress/Review notifications after the same transfer has ended, and prevent duplicate pending cancellations from reviving the UI state. Preserve unread uncertainty and exact input handoff.

findings.title: Verified download receipts are overwritten at protocol completion or next offer
findings.trigger: Successful download emits FileSaved, then Finished, or a following DownloadOffered; both may be processed in one foreground poll.
findings.impact: The only saved-file path/byte count/SHA256 receipt is replaced by generic completion text or the next offer. A user cannot inspect or retain the verified saved-file receipt after completion; it may never be painted. Batch downloads also lose every preceding saved-file receipt.
evidence: FileSaved stores data only in current.feedback at terminal_zmodem.rs:290-299
Finished calls end_zmodem and overwrites that field at terminal_zmodem.rs:379-381
DownloadOffered replaces the entire current Transfer at terminal_zmodem.rs:188-208
State/Transfer contain no saved receipt collection and render only the current summary/feedback and unresolved results
findings.verification: Source-level data-flow proof; no new test compiled.
findings.recommended_change: Keep verified per-file receipts in a bounded transfer receipt collection, separate from transient feedback, and retain them through final protocol status and later file offers.
